_comment: Missions launched from the territory map (issue #5). province: where the map offers it. map: text map in maps/. story: true = plays once. after: only offered once that mission is cleared. objective: {kind, ...} read by scripts/objective.gd (kills: count). rewards: paid on success (gilt, supplies, ink, renown, insight). fray: change to the province's Fray on success (negative pushes the Blank back). enemies: optional spawn weights that replace the province roster in data/enemies.json (#16). loot: per-kill chance [0-1] and amount range of what the party picks up on the way; retreating keeps it, being wiped out loses it.

missions.name: Prologue: Spat Out
missions.brief: Something spat you out of the Blank in the Frayed Meadow, and the Nibblers want you back. Drive them off and find your way to Hollowmark.

missions.name: Patrol: Frayed Meadow
missions.brief: The Nibblers keep crawling out of the white. Thin them out before they reach the road, and the Meadow frays a little slower.
